description: This file defines classes and enums related to managing structure elements within a PDF's accessibility framework, including stack management for structure items and marked content handling, specifically for PDF structure accessibility features.

classes.name: StructureItem
classes.description: Base class for items on the structure stack, providing common properties and virtual methods for handling structure elements.

classes.name: MarkedContentItem
classes.description: Represents a marked content item, handling begin/end operations related to tagged content within the structure.

classes.name: MarkedContentItemWithId
classes.description: Represents a marked content stream with an MCID, inheriting from MarkedContentItem.

classes.name: ArtifactItem
classes.description: Represents a marked content item that identifies an artifact within the structure.

classes.name: StructureElementItem
classes.description: Base class for structure element items, associating a PDF structure element with its category.

classes.name: GroupingItem
classes.description: Represents grouping elements in the structure stack.

classes.name: IllustrationItem
classes.description: Represents illustration elements, including properties like alternate text and bounding box.

classes.name: StructureStack
classes.description: Manages a stack of structure items and elements, providing methods to push, pop, and access current items, and to retrieve the most inner structure element.

methods.name: BeginItem
methods.description: Virtual method called when beginning the item; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: EndItem
methods.description: Virtual method called when ending the item; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: OnDrawString
methods.description: Virtual method invoked when drawing string, for subclasses to implement specific behavior.

methods.name: OnDraw
methods.description: Virtual method invoked when drawing the item, for subclasses to implement specific behavior.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a new structure item onto the stack, assigning the structure builder.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top structure item from the stack.
